The last node's pointer points to null, indicating the end of the list. Unlike arrays, linked lists do not store elements in contiguous memory locations, providing flexibility in memory allocation."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Node Structure"},{"order":5,"type":"paragraph","text":"Each node in a singly linked list typically consists of two parts: the data field, which stores the actual data, and the next pointer, which points to the subsequent node. The next pointer of the last node is usually set to null."},{"order":6,"type":"code","text":"class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.next = None"},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Traversal"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Traversal involves visiting each node in the linked list exactly once, typically to perform some operation on the data stored in each node. This is done by starting at the head node and following the 'next' pointers until the end of the list (null pointer) is reached."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"def traverse_linked_list(head):

    new_node = Node(data)
    new_node.next = head

Create a new node and set the 'next' pointer of the last node to point to the new node."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"def insert_at_end(head, data):
    new_node = Node(data)
    if not head:
        return new_node
    current = head
    while current.next:
        current = current.next
    current.next = new_node
    return head"},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"Insertion at a Specific Position"},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"To insert a node at a specific position, traverse the list to find the node before the desired position.     if position <= 0:
        return insert_at_beginning(head, data)
    new_node = Node(data)
    current = head
    count = 1
    while current and count < position:
        current = current.next
        count += 1
    if not current:
        return head
    new_node.next = current.next
    current.next = new_node
    return head"},{"order":21,"type":"subheading","text":"Deletion"},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"Deletion involves removing a node from the linked list.         return None
